metadata.question: Does the burn scar area in Apalachicola National Forest's Bradwell Bay Wilderness increase between early April, 2004, and late April, 2004?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use Landsat 5/7 Collection 2 Level 2 Surface Reflectance. Location: Bradwell Bay Wilderness (approx center 30.18, -84.58) buffered 8 km. Dates: early window 2004-04-01 to 2004-04-10 (fallbacks: to 04-15, then 03-20 to 04-20); late window 2004-04-20 to 2004-04-30 (fallbacks: to 04-16..04-30, then 04-15..05-05).
2. Masking strategy: Mask clouds, cloud shadow, cirrus, snow, fill, and radiometric saturation via QA_PIXEL and QA_RADSAT. Compute NBR per image and median composite per window.
3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: 
   - If no images after fallbacks for either window -> C1.
   - If valid pixel count after masking is 0 for either window -> C2.
   - If any computed area is null/NaN or invalid -> C3.
   - Otherwise compare burn area (NBR < 0.1) between late and early; also compute dNBR gained area for validation. If difference > 10 ha or dNBR gain > 10 ha -> A, else B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const roi = ee.Geometry.Point([-84.58, 30.18]).buffer(8000); // ~Bradwell Bay Wilderness
    const scale = 1000;
    const maxPixels = 1e9;

    // 2. Utilities
    function maskScaleNBR(img) {
      const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
      const sat = img.select('QA_RADSAT');
      const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1).eq(0) // fill
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 1).eq(0)) // dilated cloud
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 2).eq(0)) // cirrus
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0)) // cloud
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0)) // cloud shadow
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 5).eq(0)) // snow
        .and(sat.eq(0));
      const scaled = img.select(['SR_B4', 'SR_B7']).multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2);
      const nbr = scaled.expression('(nir - swir2) / (nir + swir2)', {
        nir: scaled.select('SR_B4'),
        swir2: scaled.select('SR_B7'),
      }).rename('NBR');
      return nbr.updateMask(mask);
    }

    function getCol(start, end) {
      const l5 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2');
      const l7 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2');
      return l5.merge(l7).filterBounds(roi).filterDate(start, end);
    }

    function getCompositeWindow(prefRanges, label) {
      // prefRanges: array of [start, end]
      let chosen = null;
      let counts = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < prefRanges.length; i++) {
        const start = prefRanges[i][0];
        const end = prefRanges[i][1];
        const col = getCol(start, end);
        const size = col.size();
        counts.push(ee.String(start).cat('..').cat(end).cat(' imgs: ').cat(size.format()));
        chosen = ee.Algorithms.If(size.gt(0), ee.Dictionary({start: start, end: end, size: size}), chosen);
      }
      return ee.Dictionary({chosen: chosen, counts: counts, label: label});
    }

    async function materializeComposite(winInfo) {
      const chosen = await winInfo.get('chosen').getInfo();
      if (chosen === null) return {status: 'C1'};
      const start = chosen.start;
      const end = chosen.end;
      const col = getCol(start, end).map(maskScaleNBR);
      const size = await col.size().getInfo();
      if (size === 0) return {status: 'C1'};
      const comp = col.median().select('NBR');
      return {status: 'OK', image: comp, start, end, count: size};
    }

    async function windowCountsToText(winInfo) {
      const countsList = await winInfo.get('counts').getInfo();
      // Return the first range that had data or the last tried ranges succinctly
      return countsList.join(' | ');
    }

    async function computeStats(img, label) {
      const validCount = await img.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: roi,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: maxPixels
      }).get('NBR').getInfo();
      const totalCount = await ee.Image.constant(1).reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: roi,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: maxPixels
      }).get('constant').getInfo();
      const cloudPct = (totalCount > 0) ? (100 * (1 - (validCount / totalCount))) : null;
      // Burn area where NBR < 0.1
      const burn = img.lt(0.1).updateMask(img.mask());
      const burnAreaM2 = await burn.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()).reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry: roi,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: maxPixels
      }).get('NBR').getInfo();
      return {
        label,
        validCount: validCount || 0,
        cloudPct: cloudPct,
        burnAreaHa: burnAreaM2 ? burnAreaM2 / 10000.0 : 0
      };
    }

    // 3. Define preferred date ranges
    const earlyPrefs = ee.List([
      ['2004-04-01', '2004-04-10'],
      ['2004-04-01', '2004-04-15'],
      ['2004-03-20', '2004-04-20']
    ]);
    const latePrefs = ee.List([
      ['2004-04-20', '2004-04-30'],
      ['2004-04-16', '2004-04-30'],
      ['2004-04-15', '2004-05-05']
    ]);

    const earlyWin = getCompositeWindow(earlyPrefs, 'Early');
    const lateWin = getCompositeWindow(latePrefs, 'Late');

    const earlyComp = await materializeComposite(earlyWin);
    const lateComp = await materializeComposite(lateWin);

    const earlyCountsText = await windowCountsToText(earlyWin);
    const lateCountsText = await windowCountsToText(lateWin);

    if (earlyComp.status !== 'OK' || lateComp.status !== 'OK') {
      console.log(`Early windows: ${earlyCountsText}`);
      console.log(`Late windows: ${lateCountsText}`);
      console.log('C1: Empty Collection (No images found in date/location for one or both comparison points).');
      console.log('C1: Empty Collection');
      return;
    }

    // 4. Processing and validation
    const earlyStats = await computeStats(earlyComp.image, 'Early');
    const lateStats = await computeStats(lateComp.image, 'Late');

    if (earlyStats.validCount === 0 || lateStats.validCount === 0) {
      console.log(`Early windows: ${earlyCountsText}`);
      console.log(`Late windows: ${lateCountsText}`);
      console.log(`Early valid px: ${earlyStats.validCount}, Late valid px: ${lateStats.validCount}`);
      console.log('C2: No Valid Pixels (after cloud masking).');
      console.log('C2: No Valid Pixels');
      return;
    }

    // dNBR gained area
    const dNBR = earlyComp.image.subtract(lateComp.image);
    const gained = dNBR.gt(0.1).updateMask(earlyComp.image.mask().and(lateComp.image.mask()));
    const gainedAreaM2 = await gained.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()).reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
      geometry: roi,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: maxPixels
    }).get('NBR').getInfo();
    const gainedHa = gainedAreaM2 ? gainedAreaM2 / 10000.0 : 0;

    // Check for invalid results
    const vals = [earlyStats.cloudPct, lateStats.cloudPct, earlyStats.burnAreaHa, lateStats.burnAreaHa, gainedHa];
    const invalid = vals.some(v => v === null || isNaN(v));
    if (invalid) {
      console.log('Calculation produced null/NaN values.');
      console.log('C3: Calculation Failure');
      return;
    }

    // 5. Output concise evidence and final answer
    console.log(`Early window used: ${earlyComp.start}..${earlyComp.end}; Images: ${earlyComp.count}`);
    console.log(`Late window used: ${lateComp.start}..${lateComp.end}; Images: ${lateComp.count}`);
    console.log(`Early valid px: ${earlyStats.validCount}, cloud%: ${earlyStats.cloudPct.toFixed(1)}`);
    console.log(`Late valid px: ${lateStats.validCount}, cloud%: ${lateStats.cloudPct.toFixed(1)}`);
    console.log(`Burn area early (ha): ${earlyStats.burnAreaHa.toFixed(1)}`);
    console.log(`Burn area late (ha): ${lateStats.burnAreaHa.toFixed(1)}`);
    const diffHa = lateStats.burnAreaHa - earlyStats.burnAreaHa;
    console.log(`Diff late-early (ha): ${diffHa.toFixed(1)}`);
    console.log(`dNBR gained area (ha): ${gainedHa.toFixed(1)}`);

    const increased = (diffHa > 10) || (gainedHa > 10);
    if (increased) {
      console.log('A: Yes');
    } else {
      console.log('B: No');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
